# data.docker_dockerfile

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Reads, parses and renders one Dockerfile: from `content`, a local `path`, an https `url`, an `image` history (approximate), or written with ordered `stage` / `instruction` blocks. Every source yields the same outputs: the re-rendered `dockerfile` (+ `dockerfile_sha256`), the text as read in `source_dockerfile` (+ `source_dockerfile_sha256`), and structured `stages` (each instruction with all its flags as the object named by its lowercase keyword, JSON-encoded), `directives`, `global_args`, `exposed_ports`, `base_images`.

Builder mode keeps instruction order with one `instruction` block per instruction holding exactly one keyword block (`run`, `copy`, `env`, ...): Terraform keeps the order of blocks of one type, not across types. `onbuild = true` on a keyword block writes `ONBUILD <instruction>`. MAINTAINER is read from existing Dockerfiles but cannot be written: use `label { labels = { "org.opencontainers.image.authors" = "..." } }`. `check.skip` names outside the pinned rule list (frontend 1.28) give a warning, not an error, because a newer `syntax` may add rules.

| `exec_form` | `list(string)` | optional |  |  | The command in exec form (`HEALTHCHECK CMD ["executable", "param"]`), run without a shell. Conflicts with `shell_form`. |
| `interval` | `string` | optional |  |  | `--interval` duration (default 30s). |
| `none` | `bool` | optional |  |  | `HEALTHCHECK NONE`: disable any healthcheck inherited from the base image. |
| `onbuild` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Wraps the instruction in `ONBUILD` (Q30): it runs when a later build uses this image as its base. |
| `retries` | `number` | optional |  |  | `--retries` count (default 3). |
| `shell_form` | `string` | optional |  |  | The command in shell form (`HEALTHCHECK CMD <command>`), run through the stage's SHELL. One line; conflicts with `exec_form`. |
| `start_interval` | `string` | optional |  |  | `--start-interval` duration (default 5s; Docker Engine 25.0+). |
| `start_period` | `string` | optional |  |  | `--start-period` duration (default 0s). |
| `timeout` | `string` | optional |  |  | `--timeout` duration (default 30s). |

### `stage.instruction.label`

single block. `LABEL`: image metadata; use `org.opencontainers.image.authors` instead of the deprecated MAINTAINER (Q29).

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `labels` | `map(string)` | optional |  |  | Label keys and values, rendered sorted by key and quoted where needed. Required in this block. |
| `onbuild` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Wraps the instruction in `ONBUILD` (Q30): it runs when a later build uses this image as its base. |

### `stage.instruction.run`

single block. `RUN`: execute a command at build time and commit the result as a new layer. Set `shell_form`, `exec_form` or `heredocs`.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `device` | `list(object)` | optional |  |  | One `--device` flag per entry (Dockerfile 1.27, BuildKit 0.20+): a CDI device for this RUN. |
| `exec_form` | `list(string)` | optional |  |  | The command in exec form (`RUN ["executable", "param"]`), run without a shell. Conflicts with `shell_form`. |
| `heredocs` | `list(object)` | optional |  |  | Here-documents (`<<EOF`) attached to the instruction, in order. Each becomes a `<<DELIM` word on the instruction line followed by its body. |
| `mount` | `list(object)` | optional |  |  | One `--mount` flag per entry (Dockerfile 1.2): a bind, cache, tmpfs, secret or ssh mount for this RUN only. |
| `network` | `string` | optional |  |  | `--network` (Dockerfile 1.3): `default`, `none` or `host` (needs the network.host entitlement). |
| `onbuild` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Wraps the instruction in `ONBUILD` (Q30): it runs when a later build uses this image as its base. |
| `security` | `string` | optional |  |  | `--security` (Dockerfile 1.20): `sandbox` (default) or `insecure` (needs the security.insecure entitlement). |
| `shell_form` | `string` | optional |  |  | The command in shell form (`RUN <command>`), run through the stage's SHELL. One line; conflicts with `exec_form`. |

### `stage.instruction.run.device`

nested attribute, list(object). One `--device` flag per entry (Dockerfile 1.27, BuildKit 0.20+): a CDI device for this RUN.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | required |  |  | CDI device name: `vendor/device`, `vendor/device=name`, `vendor/device=*` or a class. |
| `required` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Fail when the device is not available. |

### `stage.instruction.run.heredocs`

nested attribute, list(object). Here-documents (`<<EOF`) attached to the instruction, in order. Each becomes a `<<DELIM` word on the instruction line followed by its body.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `content` | `string` | required |  |  | The body up to the delimiter; a trailing newline is added when missing. |
| `delimiter` | `string` | optional |  |  | The delimiter word. Default `EOF` (`EOF1`, `EOF2` ... when several). |
| `expand` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Expand build variables in the body. Default true; false quotes the delimiter (`<<"EOF"`). |
| `strip_tabs` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Use `<<-` so leading tabs are stripped from the body. |

### `stage.instruction.run.mount`

nested attribute, list(object). One `--mount` flag per entry (Dockerfile 1.2): a bind, cache, tmpfs, secret or ssh mount for this RUN only.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | `string` | optional |  |  | Expose a secret as this environment variable (Dockerfile 1.10). |
| `from` | `string` | optional |  |  | Build stage, context or image to mount from (bind, cache). |
| `gid` | `number` | optional |  |  | Group id of the mount (default 0). |
| `id` | `string` | optional |  |  | Cache id, or secret / ssh id. |
| `mode` | `string` | optional |  |  | File mode in octal (cache 0755, secret 0400, ssh 0600 by default). |
| `required` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Fail when the secret or ssh agent is not available (default false). |
| `ro` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Read-only cache mount. |
| `rw` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Allow writes to a bind mount (discarded after the RUN). |
| `sharing` | `string` | optional |  |  | Cache sharing mode: `shared` (default), `private` or `locked`. |
| `size` | `string` | optional |  |  | Size limit of a tmpfs mount. |
| `source` | `string` | optional |  |  | Path in `from` (bind, cache). |
| `target` | `string` | optional |  |  | Mount path (required for bind, cache and tmpfs). |
| `type` | `string` | optional |  |  | `bind` (default), `cache`, `tmpfs`, `secret` or `ssh`. |
| `uid` | `number` | optional |  |  | User id of the mount (default 0). |

### `stage.instruction.shell`

single block. `SHELL`: the shell used for the shell form of later instructions.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `onbuild` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Wraps the instruction in `ONBUILD` (Q30): it runs when a later build uses this image as its base. |
| `shell` | `list(string)` | optional |  |  | Executable and parameters, e.g. `["/bin/bash", "-c"]` (JSON form only). Required in this block. |

### `stage.instruction.stopsignal`

single block. `STOPSIGNAL`: the signal that stops the container.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `onbuild` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Wraps the instruction in `ONBUILD` (Q30): it runs when a later build uses this image as its base. |
| `signal` | `string` | optional |  |  | `SIG<NAME>` or an unsigned number. Required in this block. |

### `stage.instruction.user`

single block. `USER`: the user (and group) for later instructions and the container.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | `string` | optional |  |  | Group name or GID. |
| `onbuild` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Wraps the instruction in `ONBUILD` (Q30): it runs when a later build uses this image as its base. |
| `user` | `string` | optional |  |  | User name or UID. Required in this block. |

### `stage.instruction.volume`

single block. `VOLUME`: mount points for externally mounted volumes.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `onbuild` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Wraps the instruction in `ONBUILD` (Q30): it runs when a later build uses this image as its base. |
| `paths` | `list(string)` | optional |  |  | Mount point paths (the JSON form is used when one holds whitespace). Required in this block. |

### `stage.instruction.workdir`

single block. `WORKDIR`: the working directory for later instructions and the container.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `onbuild` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Wraps the instruction in `ONBUILD` (Q30): it runs when a later build uses this image as its base. |
| `path` | `string` | optional |  |  | Absolute path, or relative to the previous WORKDIR; may hold $VAR. Required in this block. |

## Example

```terraform
# Parse an existing Dockerfile and use its structure.
data "docker_dockerfile" "app" {
  path = "${path.module}/app/Dockerfile"
}

output "build_targets" {
  value = data.docker_dockerfile.app.stage_names
}

# Rebuild the image when the parsed Dockerfile changes.
resource "docker_image" "app" {
  name = "registry.example.com/app:latest"
  build {
    context = "${path.module}/app"
  }
  triggers = {
    dockerfile_sha256 = data.docker_dockerfile.app.dockerfile_sha256
  }
}

# Write a Dockerfile with ordered blocks: one `instruction` block per
# instruction, each holding exactly one keyword block.
data "docker_dockerfile" "generated" {
  syntax = "docker/dockerfile:1"
  check {
    skip = ["JSONArgsRecommended"]
  }

  global_arg {
    name    = "GO_VERSION"
    default = "1.22"
  }

  stage {
    name     = "build"
    from     = "golang:$${GO_VERSION}"
    platform = "$BUILDPLATFORM"
    instruction {
      workdir {
        path = "/src"
      }
    }
    instruction {
      copy {
        sources     = ["."]
        destination = "."
      }
    }
    instruction {
      run {
        shell_form = "go build -o /out/app ./cmd/app"
        mount = [
          { type = "cache", target = "/root/.cache/go-build" },
        ]
      }
    }
  }

  stage {
    from = "gcr.io/distroless/static"
    instruction {
      label {
        # MAINTAINER is deprecated: use the OCI authors label.
        labels = { "org.opencontainers.image.authors" = "ops@example.com" }
      }
    }
    instruction {
      copy {
        from        = "build"
        sources     = ["/out/app"]
        destination = "/app"
        link        = true
      }
    }
    instruction {
      expose {
        ports = [{ port = "8080" }]
      }
    }
    instruction {
      entrypoint {
        exec_form = ["/app"]
      }
    }
  }
}

# The rendered text is sensitive (ENV values and ARG defaults are inline).
output "generated_dockerfile" {
  value     = data.docker_dockerfile.generated.dockerfile
  sensitive = true
}

# Approximate Dockerfile of a local image, rebuilt from its history.
data "docker_dockerfile" "nginx" {
  image = "nginx:latest"
}
```
